tools.name: search_trips
tools.description:
Find 57hours guided adventures that can be booked now.

Every result has at least one open departure matching the filters and comes
with its next matching departure and its lowest matching price. Returns
{trips: [...], totalMatches, nextOffset}. When a keyword query matches no
trip on all its words,

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description:
One trip in detail: description, highlights, location, length, skill
level, rating, guides and its next open departures with spots and prices.

tools.name: list_departures
tools.description:
Every open departure of one trip, soonest first, with spots left, price
and a bookingUrl that opens checkout for that date and party size. Returns {tripId, name, url, departures: [...],
totalMatches, nextOffset}.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description:
The activities and countries that have bookable trips right now, each
with its trip count, plus the currencies prices can be shown in. Use the
names as search_trips' activity and country filters.
